name: Iwate (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iwate town emblem in white: a ring with a bar across, flanked by wing-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Iwate, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1956.

features.role: Iwate town emblem — a ring with a bar across, flanked by wing-like strokes
